label: Suggest / Propose
message: Can we meet at the coffee shop near campus at 10 tomorrow to go over the slides?
instruction: Suggest an alternative or different plan for meeting at the coffee shop.
response: I'm not a coffee drinker at the moment, taking a break. lets just meet at the library instead

label: Correct / Restate
message: The midterm is Tuesday. Want to do a study session Sunday night over video call?
instruction: Correct or rephrase something about the exam study session.
response: sure, I may not be available for the video part but we can sync through audio

label: Soften / Hedge
message: Let's catch the 9:30 showing of the new sci-fi movie on Saturday. I can buy the tickets.
instruction: Respond about the movie night plan in a polite or softer way.
response: 9:30pm right? and which movie? your treat? aw you don't have to do that

label: 5W1H Question
message: Hey, want to try the new ramen place downtown Friday at 7? I heard it's really good.
instruction: Ask a what / where / when / how / why question about dinner at the new ramen place.
response: 7pm? I love Raman! sure, lets do it! What's the name of the place? Who did you hear from about it?

label: Elaborate / Expand
message: Tickets for the concert next month are $85 each. Should we get them before they sell out?
instruction: Add more detail or explanation about the concert tickets.
response: where are the seats for $85? which concert again? I forgot. tempting, lets see if reselling isn't too bad before pulling the trigger.

label: Reverify / Confirm
message: Let's start going to the gym at 6 a.m. on Mondays and Wednesdays.
instruction: Check or confirm something about the morning workout plan.
response: oof, I am not a morning person but which workout will we start with?

label: Summarize / Condense
message: Road trip to Santa Cruz this Saturday? We'd leave at 8 a.m. and I'll drive.
instruction: Summarize the idea about the weekend road trip more briefly.
response: That's nice of you, I do fall asleep in the car in the mornings so just to warn you. hope the water is warm enough to dip our feet in at least

label: Full Agree
message: I think we should split the project into five parts and finish our drafts by Sunday night.
instruction: Agree with this idea about the group project plan.
response: okay, how do you want to split it 5 ways? who will work on which part?

label: Partial Agree + Modification
message: Let's throw a surprise party for Sam at my place next Friday. Everyone brings a dish.
instruction: Agree with the idea about the surprise birthday party, but suggest a small change.
response: I'd love to join this potluck! I'll bring dessert, maybe baklava or a pie of some sort. Let's make sure to include Sam's new friend from out of state :)

label: Acknowledge
message: Want to study at the library tomorrow from 2 to 6? I booked a room on the third floor.
instruction: Give a short acknowledgment about studying at the library.
response: lets do 4-6pm and sure that sounds great

label: Refuse / Decline
message: Let's catch the 9:30 showing of the new sci-fi movie on Saturday. I can buy the tickets.
instruction: Decline or say no to something about the movie night plan.
response: sorry I got plans tonight, enjoy though!

label: Full Disagree
message: The midterm is Tuesday. Want to do a study session Sunday night over video call?
instruction: Disagree with this idea about the exam study session.
response: I don't think we need to do this. The exam seems pretty straight forward

label: Direct / Blunt
message: Let's throw a surprise party for Sam at my place next Friday. Everyone brings a dish.
instruction: Respond about the surprise birthday party in a short and direct way.

label: Express Emotion
message: Road trip to Santa Cruz this Saturday? We'd leave at 8 a.m. and I'll drive.
instruction: Respond about the weekend road trip while showing how you feel (happy, annoyed, excited, etc.).
response: sounds great! I am so excited to see you all again! We should get some snacks and stuff. This is gonna be so awesome!
